interpretation.success: Expanded burned-event training plus causal refresh restored strong localization while preserving stable incident handling. By 10 hours, 64.4% of all leaks and 82.5% of leaks with a usable snapshot had the true node in the top three out of 31 candidates.
interpretation.refresh_value: Across the full incident duration, dynamic refresh moved 11 events from outside top-three to inside top-three. Conditional top-three localization improved from 79.7% on the first available snapshot to 96.9% with refreshes.
interpretation.deadline_limitation: The six-hour refresh cadence is too slow relative to a ten-hour action target. With a five-hour observation window, a second refresh often becomes ready around 10.5 hours, so by-10h metrics equal the first-snapshot metrics on this cohort.
interpretation.next_iteration: Keep detector, incident hysteresis, and localizer training strategy fixed; shorten localization refresh cadence to four hours so at least two causal rankings can fit inside a ten-hour action window. Test on a fresh sealed Hanoi-005 cohort.
